title: Testing the Foundations of Signal Detection Theory in Recognition Memory
authors: David Kellen, Samuel Winiger, John C. Dunn, Henrik Singmann
caption_short: The two kinds of test trial in Experiment 4: a five-word subsetting display in which the participant selects every word judged old, and a follow-up two-alternative choice between two words that received the same judgement.
